# Tiny Tool (full agent docs)

A minimal non Rust project documented through the generic file-set renderer: no manifests, no registry, just values plus fragments.

Install: `npm install tiny-tool`. Usage: `tiny-tool --help`.

# Tiny Tool

A minimal non Rust project documented through the generic file-set renderer: no manifests, no registry, just values plus fragments.

Install with `npm install tiny-tool`, then run `tiny-tool --help`.
